_what: Read-only source mirrors used by audits and implementation. Fetched into mirrors/ (gitignored) by docs/parity/tools/fetch_mirrors.py. A commit pins every package; documents cite these files as mirrors/cm6/<package>/... at the commits below.

view.note: main after the 6.43.14 release (2026-10-17, 'Improve Home/End behavior in bidi text'); package.json still says 6.43.14

optional.zed: Not pinned and not fetched by the script. Only its Apache-2.0 crates may be opened (rules.md §5.3). Place a checkout at mirrors/zed/ when a task needs one.
optional.markdown-oxide: Not pinned and not fetched by the script (Apache-2.0). Place a checkout at mirrors/markdown-oxide/ when a task needs one.
